picks.title: Adobe Announces It Is Further Integrating Into ChatGPT With New Unified Plugin
picks.excerpt: Adobe and OpenAI have shipped a single unified plugin that exposes more than 70 Creative Cloud and productivity tools inside ChatGPT. Filmmakers can now describe an outcome and let the chatbot orchestrate which Adobe app actually does the work.
picks.rationale: Freshest and most actionable item in the pool: the entry point to Premiere, Photoshop and Express moves from the app to a chat prompt, which changes where post work actually starts tomorrow.

picks.title: Brevidy for Adobe Premiere Pro – AI Captions, Automatic Social Clips, and Vertical Reframing in One Panel
picks.excerpt: Brevidy is an AI toolkit that lives inside Adobe Premiere Pro, handling captioning, automatic clip extraction from long-form edits, vertical reframing and stock browsing in one panel. It targets the export-upload-reimport loop editors currently run for short-form deliverables.
picks.rationale: A concrete panel an editor can install today that collapses the whole short-form deliverable loop back inside the NLE — the most directly usable tool release in the batch.

picks.title: Disney And TikTok Strike Deal To Bring Fan-Made Short-Form Videos To Disney+
picks.excerpt: Disney and TikTok will let creators build short-form videos from hundreds of official Disney assets, with selected results surfacing on Disney+'s vertical feed. Cartoon Brew contrasts it with the abandoned Disney–Sora deal: this one is asset remixing, not text-to-video generation.
picks.rationale: The biggest structural news of the day and a clear answer to the Sora question: a major IP holder licensing sanctioned assets for remix instead of open generation.

picks.title: Is this the future of filmmaking?
picks.excerpt: Damian Allen walks through a "hybrid film set" built on Beeble's SwitchX and SwitchLight, where real actors and real camera moves are kept while backgrounds and lighting are regenerated in post. His framing for artists: "the AI result is a pass, not a result."
picks.rationale: A named artist walking through an actual hybrid-set pipeline, with the sharpest working principle in the pool — treat the generative output as a pass to be graded, not a finished shot.

picks.title: Pixar Co-Founder Ed Catmull Joins Jury For GenAI Film Competition
picks.excerpt: Pixar co-founder and former Disney Animation president Ed Catmull has joined the jury of the Higgsfield Global Film Festival, a competition devoted entirely to generative-AI filmmaking. Higgsfield framed the move around Pixar's history of pairing artists with engineers.
picks.rationale: The strongest legitimacy signal yet for GenAI filmmaking — the person who built Pixar's technical culture sitting on the jury — and an open competition creators can actually enter.
